title: Oil near $89.50 as Hormuz tanker attacks and Houthi missiles keep a risk premium
summary: WTI crude held around $89.50 amid Middle East tensions after earlier tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz.
ict: Bullish oil tends to weigh on USD/CAD (Canada exports oil), but the CAD seasonal is weak from September to Christmas, which favours USD/CAD. When the signals conflict, ICT waits for price structure to decide.
